messages:
Alex W: I'm handing off primary to @Maria C — quick context: we got a P1 pager earlier for model-serve-high-latency in us-west2. Incident Bot posted alerts; latency spikes correlated with KV cache thrashing. I'm still on bridge but need to step away for the next 25m. Summary + actions below.

Incident Bot: [ALERT] model-serve-high-latency | region=us-west2 | severity=high | active_since=1765431980

Maria C: taking primary. Can you paste the latest runbook link and quick remediation steps?

Alex W: Yep — runbook: https://docs.internal/redwood/runbooks/model-serve-latency. TL;DR: 1) check autoscaler and queue depth, 2) inspect KV cache hit rate and restart cache host if >20% error, 3) failover to standby model variant if sustained latency >500ms.

Sherry K: adding quick pointers we used earlier: run cache probe, then scale downstream worker pool. Commands:
```
# check auto-scaling groups and queue depth
curl -sS "https://internal-api.redwood/ops/queues?region=us-west2" | jq .
./infractl scale --pool model-infer-usw2 --replicas 6
```
If autoscaler is stuck, force scale first then investigate.

Sam T: Logs show a lot of `KVCache::miss` and `socket_timeout` errors around 1765431800-1765431950. I grabbed the quick grep:
```
grep -R "KVCache::miss" /var/log/model-serve/* | tail -n 50
```
That aligns with the latency spike.

Alex W: customer impact assessment: hosted-api error rate is low (0.3%) but p95 latency for text-generation rose from 180ms -> 820ms. No major errors, but interactive apps will feel lag. A handful of high-value customers in us-west2 reported degraded responsiveness. I've DM'd Customer Success with the list.

Maria C: ok. Immediate next actions I'll own: 1) run cache health checks, 2) if cache error rate >15% restart cache nodes, 3) if latency doesn't drop in 3m, roll requests to model-variant:fast-quant (fallback).

Sherry K: cache health check steps:
1) SSH to cache host pool `cache-usw2-*`
2) run `cachectl metrics --since 10m` look for `error_rate` and `eviction_rate`
3) if error_rate > 0.15 do `cachectl restart --host <host>` one at a time
4) monitor `curl -sS localhost:9100/metrics | grep kv_cache`

Alex W: adding an emergency shortcut: if you need to immediately reduce load, flip routing to dedicated tier for customers on us-west2 via the routing console: https://console.redwood/internal/routing. Use the temporary policy `usw2-protect-2026-03`.

PagerDuty: Incident assigned to Maria C (primary). Escalation: Sherry K (secondary) at +1 if not acknowledged in 2m.

Maria C: acknowledged. Starting cache checks now. Will post results and any forced restarts.

(3m later) Maria C: cache metrics: error_rate 0.22 on cache-usw2-3, eviction spike at 48%. Restarting cache-usw2-3 now (one node).

Alex W: good. After restart watch p95 and KV hit rate. If restart doesn't help within 3m do variant failover.

Incident Bot: [UPDATE] cache-usw2-3 restarted by Maria C at 1765432250

Sam T: after restart p95 dropped to ~310ms and KVCache::miss decreased by ~60%. Still above baseline but much better. Recommend keep monitoring and avoid global failover.

Maria C: keeping primary. I'll stay on bridge until p95 stabilizes under 250ms for 10m. Sherry, if any customer escalations come in can you take point?

Sherry K: on it. I've posted the customer-impact note to #customer-impact and flagged top 5 customers in the shared doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/incident-logs/1765432100.

Alex W: handoff complete — primary to Maria C, secondary Sherry K. My remaining notes:
- Known mitigation steps in runbook (same link): https://docs.internal/redwood/runbooks/model-serve-latency
- Quick command to failover if necessary:
```
# roll traffic to variant
./trafficctl set-route --region=us-west2 --model=model-main --variant=fast-quant --percentage=100
```
- Post-mortem owner: Alex W (will draft and assign after incident closes).

Oncall Rotation: Reminder: next swap in 6h — ensure follow-up in incident timeline. :white_check_mark:

Maria C: thanks. will update in 10m and then mark handoff in the runbook. :thumbsup:

(Last update) Maria C: p95 holding at ~220ms for 12m, KV miss stable ~3%. Marking incident as mitigated from latency perspective. Leaving notes for postmortem and handover.

PagerDuty: Incident resolved by Maria C at 1765432345

Alex W: closing my handoff notes here. Thanks team — good coordination.
